candidates.title: BASS: Batched Attention-optimized Speculative Sampling
candidates.reason: Batched speculative-decoding system designed for multi-sequence serving, improving GPU utilization and generation latency over regular and single-sequence speculative decoding.

candidates.title: Lancet: Accelerating Mixture-of-Experts Training via Whole Graph Computation-Communication Overlapping
candidates.reason: Compiler-based MoE training system that overlaps all-to-all communication with computation across the whole training graph.

candidates.title: Clover: Regressive Lightweight Speculative Decoding with Sequential Knowledge
candidates.reason: Lightweight speculative-decoding method focused on improving draft-token accuracy and inference acceleration with sequential knowledge.

candidates.title: NeMo-Aligner: Scalable Toolkit for Efficient Model Alignment
candidates.reason: Scalable alignment training toolkit with optimized RLHF/DPO/etc. implementations demonstrated up to thousand-GPU scale and 405B-class models.
